address: 9, Section 2, Jinan Road, Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: The light-filled interior is dotted with Chinese perforated window screens, while wooden benches set a casual scene. The husband-and-wife team serves a menu that hinges on chicken broth, alongside Jiangzhe-style dishes made with local ingredients. Try golden chicken soup – corn-fed hen is slow-cooked for six hours with Jinhua ham and bamboo shoot to develop rich flavours and gelatinous texture. Shanghai cabbage rice tastes rustic and is deeply satisfying.
